title: 고등교육기관의 자체평가에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1

Article 6 (Support for Self-Evaluation)
The Minister of Education may, within budgetary limits, provide support for expenses necessary for schools to conduct self-evaluations smoothly. [Amended on March 23, 2013.]
